answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock a bond for 30 days and allocates voting power in proportion to bonded capital, with no bonus for extra accounts. Its copper, onyx and zenith service tiers follow the same rule. Splitting one bond among a thousand fake agents buys no extra influence: to control 10% of voting power, an attacker must fund 10% of all bonded capital and bear the cost of keeping it locked.
